    PretorsionImageClosed.Statement.IsShortPreexact.of_quotient

    Lifting short preexact sequences along quotients #

    Let π : X ⟶ V be an epimorphism, and let ι : A ⟶ X be a subobject which is the preimage of a subobject u_V : B ⟶ V along π, with π restricting to an epimorphism π_A : A ⟶ B. If B ⟶ V ⟶ F is short Z-preexact and every morphism from A to an object of Z vanishes on the kernel of π_A, then A ⟶ X ⟶ F is short Z-preexact (IsShortPreexact.of_quotient).

    This is the inductive step in the proof that the second components paired with a fixed first component are closed under intersections (Proposition 3.2): it replaces the manuscript's transport argument (3.1) and Lemma 3.1.
